facts: About 15,100 km2, about 1 million people (2021 census)
Borders Poland to the south and Lithuania to the north and east
worth_knowing: A semi-exclave of Russia on the Baltic Sea. Baltiysk is Russia's only Baltic port that remains ice-free in winter.
